Definition
[$L^p(0,T;X)$] 1. ch5:5.9-def-3\group Bochner Spaces The space \[ L^p(0, T; X) \] consists of all measurable functions $\mathbf{u} : [0, T] \to X$ with

  • $\| \mathbf{u}\| _{L^p(0,T;X)} := \left(\int _0^T \| \mathbf{u}(t)\| ^p\, dt\right)^{1/p} < \infty $

for $1 \le p < \infty $, and

  • $\| \mathbf{u}\| _{L^\infty (0,T;X)} := \text{ess sup}_{0 \le t \le T} \| \mathbf{u}(t)\| < \infty $.
